name: Gobihadros
sum: A basal hadrosauroid of the Late Cretaceous Bayanshiree Formation of Mongolia, known from many bones of different growth stages.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; from the Bayanshiree Formation, Mongolia.
material: Multiple individuals, studied for growth and senescence by Slowiak and colleagues.
biology: Bone studies point to uninterrupted growth in a non-polar hadrosaur and to age-related changes in old individuals.
author: Tsogtbaatar et al. 2019
